description: Look up a packaged food by its UPC/EAN barcode in Open Food Facts. Returns macros per 100 g, a `source`, and, when known, `serving_grams`/`serving_label` for one household serving. All calorie and macro values, including carbohydrates, are estimates from USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts, the user's own entry or an AI assistant's estimate — approximate, not lab-measured or specific to a package or batch, and not suitable for insulin dosing (including carb counting for a meal bolus), blood-glucose prediction or any other medical decision.
name: lookup_barcode

items.description: A food match. Macros are PER 100 g — scale to the portion before logging.

macros.description: Calories and macros. Estimates, not lab-measured; not for insulin dosing.
